summary: Translation Hub's post-editing workflow enables administrators to organize translators and post-editing groups, while portal users can request post-edits that translators review and edit.
extended_definition: Translation Hub's post-editing workflow enables administrators to organize translators and post-editing groups, while portal users can request post-edits that translators review and edit.

supporting_pages.title: Post-editing \_|\_ Translation Hub \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: In the Post-editing in progress section, Translation Hub shows if your request is in one of the following states: Assigned : You have submitted a request but a translator has not yet accepted the editing task.
Translation Hub shows you post-editing groups that contain a translator who is fluent in your source and translated content language pairs.

The status of your document changes to Post-editing completed Segment details During a post-edit, you can select a segment to view its translation details, such as its machine translation quality prediction (MTQP) score, in the Segment detail pane.

supporting_pages.title: Enable post-editing requests \_|\_ Translation Hub \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Translation Hub shows relevant post-editing groups that contain translators who have fluency with the source and target language of their translated documents.
Translation Hub post-editing lets you bring in your own translators to review machine translated content.
In the Translation Hub section of the Google Cloud console, go to the Post-editing page.

supporting_pages.title: "Save and reuse human-reviewed translations \_|\_ Translation Hub \_|\_ Google\
evidence_snippets: A default translation memory is helpful to consistently apply a set of human-reviewed translations, to capture edits during post-editing, or both.
As part of the post-editing process, Translation Hub populates your translation memory with post-edited translations.
Set a default translation memory You can set a default translation memory that Translation Hub automatically selects when portal users request a translation.

supporting_pages.title: Review and edit translations \_|\_ Translation Hub \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Go to https://translationhub.cloud.google.com/ to sign in to the post-editing portal.
In the translator portal, Translation Hub lists the available post-editing tasks.
Edit a translation After receiving an email notification that a new document is ready for review, click the included link to go to the post-editing portal.
